title: Mercedes BR Jaya Half Marathon & Duathlon 2026 Review: A Premium-Brand Malaysian Race
seo_title: Mercedes BR Jaya Half Marathon 2026 Review | Kulai Johor Race
meta_description: The Mercedes BR Jaya Half Marathon & Duathlon 2026: November 15 at AEON Mall Kulai Jaya, Johor. 21K, 10K, and 5K plus duathlon — registration open.
dek: Set for 15 November 2026 at AEON Mall Kulai Jaya in Johor, this Mercedes-branded event combines a half marathon with a duathlon option. Three run distances plus multisport with registration open.
verdict: The Mercedes BR Jaya Half Marathon & Duathlon brings premium automotive branding to a Johor race with an unusual twist: a duathlon option alongside the standard run distances (21K, 10K, 5K). The Mercedes brand presence suggests above-average production values — quality medals, well-designed race tees, and a polished finish-line experience. Registration is open via JomRun. For runners who want a brand-backed Malaysian race with a duathlon option — or just a well-produced half marathon — this is a distinctive pick.

sections.heading: Duathlon + Half Marathon
paragraphs: The duathlon option — run-bike-run — distinguishes this from a standard running event and opens it to the multisport community. [1] AEON Mall Kulai Jaya provides the familiar mall-anchored race hub with parking, facilities, and post-race amenities built in.

faqs.question: What is the Mercedes BR Jaya event?
